subject: Error in x %*% y : non-matching dimensions (inlabru)

messages.author: de3190e0e6f4a690
messages.subject: Error in x %*% y : non-matching dimensions (inlabru)
parts:
Hi all,

I'm working on a model in inlabru using a set of spatial covariates- two of which are categorical.

+ Mixed_cov(map= Mixed_SPDF, model = "factor") + Mono_cov(map= Mono_SPDF, model = "factor") +

The 'fit' stage runs fine, and I get normal results from the summary of this model.
The model runs fine until the model_pred stage, where after creating new locations for the prediction, using pixels from the mesh -newlocations <- pixels(mesh)-, the predict function does not run, and this error appears:

Fig_pred <- predict(Fig_fit, newlocations, ~ exp(Fig_GRF + ACD_cov + Elev_cov + Mono_cov + Mixed_cov + FigRivers_cov +Intercept) *0.2549233, n.samples = 100)
Error in x %*% y : non-matching dimensions

All the covariates are on the same CRS so I'm not sure which dimensions this is referring to.
Any advice would be really appreciated.

Cheers,
Sol

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error in x %*% y : non-matching dimensions (inlabru)
parts:
Like I replied in off-list emails, please convert your 2-level factors
into 0/1 covariates instead, and use model="linear" to be sure to
avoid overparameterisation and possible bugs in the experimental
model="factor" feature in inlabru.
It is likely the error is related to that.

Finn
